description: Minimal IPC access for content tabs (which can browse to arbitrary external sites) - grants only allow-report-context-menu, allow-report-favicon, allow-report-content-click, allow-report-login-submit, allow-report-login-form-present, and allow-open-link-in-new-tab, scoped to webviews matching the content-* label prefix create_tab_webview assigns. 'remote' is required since content tabs load non-local pages by design; every one of these commands must therefore treat its inputs as untrusted (a remote page's own JS could call any of them directly, not just context_menu.js/favicon.js/password_capture.js/an installed extension's script) - validate rather than trust. report_content_click takes no input, so there's nothing there to validate. open_link_in_new_tab is the first of these that performs a browser action immediately on invocation rather than just stashing data for a later human-gated step (the native context menu, in ctx-open-link's case) - see its own comment in main.rs for the scheme-allowlist and per-webview rate-limit that guard it against becoming a tab-spam vector. Guarded again directly in main.rs via require_content(), mirroring chrome.json's require_chrome() pattern.
